title: Weak Spot: San Antonio Hardcore Band Begins a New Age via Killer EP - NewsBreak
text:
By By No Echo ,
2 days ago Since first appearing on No Echo in 2024, San Antonio hardcore band Weak Spot have kept a steady pace—playing consistently in their hometown, making trips to nearby cities like Austin, and staying locked in on writing new material. “We’ve been playing as many shows as we can in our hometown of San Antonio, along with a few in Austin,” vocalist Sean Cloutier tells No Echo. “We really wanted to stay consistent and keep the momentum going, so we just kept pushing forward.” Read full article
